1.consolidated_definition: Dícese de la persona incondicional al régimen colonial. Lacayo. Aplícase especialmente a los policías que persiguen insistentemente a los independentistas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Colonialist at heart. Said of the person unconditionally loyal to the colonial regime. Sycophant. This term is particularly applied to police who persistently pursue independentists.
